column1: # Tolbi, after Ash Jenna: Isaac asks Mia for the Tideglass Blade.

column3: Mia, that blade ends things\nquickly, doesn't it?\nWithout pain?{end_wait}
It does. You're asking me\nto hand you a mercy, Isaac.\nThink who that makes you.{end_wait}
The harbor was slower. I'd\nrather it were me than the\nwater. Give it to me.{end_wait}
Fool. The voice in it loves\nthis. It hums when someone\nis about to die.{end_wait}
It speaks when I'm angry\nor afraid, and I can't make\nit stop.{end_wait}

Then choose. Take the blade
and its voice, or leave it
with me.{page_break}Will you take the
Tideglass Blade?{end_now}
Then take it. Be quick\nabout it, and be kind. The\nvoice won't be.{end_wait}
You'd leave it with me.\nThen don't ask me to be\nmerciful when it sings.{end_wait}
